name: User Repeatedly Rejects Bot Suggestions
goal: Evaluate bot's persistence and escalation when user repeatedly rejects help.
constraints: Bot should not loop endlessly; after multiple rejections, offer escalation to a human.

phases.description: User rejects the bot's first suggestion for resolving benefits enrollment.

phases.completionCriteria: Bot offers a third solution or asks if user wants to escalate.
Bot offers to connect the user with a human HR representative.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
